speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. Since you are a newborn presenting with feeding intolerance and bilious vomiting, I need to ask you a few quick questions. Has your baby passed any stool yet, and is it green or black in color?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, 3050-g (6-lb 12-oz) male, six hours post delivery. The newborn has had several episodes of bilious vomiting and is intolerant to feeding since birth. Was born at term following an uncomplicated pregnancy, though the mother missed several prenatal checkups. The patient's older brother underwent surgery for pyloric stenosis as an infant.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Malrotation with Volvulus. Given the bilious vomiting in a term newborn and family history of pyloric stenosis, surgical emergency is suspected.
